text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-Induced Akathisia.

The clinical picture of a 23-year-old male with recent risperidone initiation, significant psychiatric improvement, and a new complaint of a constant internal urge to move without significant tremor or rigidity is highly characteristic of akathisia. This side effect typically presents as severe restlessness and is often misinterpreted as anxiety. No further diagnostic tests are required for this diagnosis; management involves dose reduction or switching to an antipsychotic with a lower risk of extrapyramidal symptoms.
